Keeping the selling price of USD 9.00 for House lunch bowl · Decision sample yields USD 5.15 contribution per unit (USD 515.00 across 100 baseline units) at a 57.22% margin (5722 Bps), missing the 60% policy target (6000 Bps).

By not moving to the recommended USD 9.70 price (which yields USD 5.85 contribution per unit and USD 585.00 across 100 units at a 60.31% margin / 6031 Bps), you give up reaching the recommended USD 5.85 unit contribution, USD 585.00 total contribution, and 60.31% margin.

Recorded cause: Confirmed cost increased by USD 0.35 from USD 3.50 to USD 3.85. To meet target at USD 9.00, a variable-cost reduction of USD 0.25 per unit is required. Volume changes are owner assumptions, not predicted demand.

Across 100 baseline units, total contribution is $515.00, compared to $585.00 under the recommended $9.70 price option. Reaching the 60.00% target at the $9.00 price requires a variable-cost reduction of $0.25 per unit.

Recorded Cause:
Stock movement #10 recorded an ingredient cost increase of $0.35 (rising from $3.50 to $3.85).

Assumptions:
Volume response is assumed, not predicted. Contribution excludes shared overhead, wages, rent, utilities, and unrecorded costs.
